summary: Novo Nordisk A/S filed a Form 6-K reporting updates under its ongoing share repurchase programme, originally announced on 4 February 2026, for up to DKK 15 billion over 12 months. The current tranche of up to DKK 3.8 billion runs from 4 February to 4 May 2026. As of 24 April, it had repurchased 13,407,992 B shares at an average price of DKK 256.48 per share (DKK 3.44 billion total). The company now holds 30,797,791 B shares as treasury (0.7% of share capital). This is an open-market buyback, not a tender offer; details are published daily on its website. Watch for execution pace and any future programme expansions.
